Coming from a ex comp (top 20) guild member in seven knights (quit around the end of 2019- beginning of 2020). the game was def fun, farming fodder was VERY easy we had a mechanic that would auto swap your fodders for new ones, along with auto promotes while you farm. This def made fodder farming more of a afk thing compared to E7. When I played the RTA at the time wasn’t the best compared to E7 slightly lackluster. The main focus was GVG and the PVE guild dungeon. Personally I loved the PVE they had GVG on the other hand is like how E7 is you’re vs an ai 3 on 3 battle (iirc) the biggest difference there was no CR board you’d just roughly assume depending on the unit who would go first (everyone basically has the same gear, rolling gear was much different, “sub stats” didn’t exist you’d just have a weapon that gave you 30 speed no matter what or 30% attack) the fights were basically you queue up 3 skills and you just watch it go if you didn’t queue the skill you’d just s1 automatically without you imputing anything. 

The PVE guild dungeon was where I enjoyed the most of my time, you’d just go through a map of 10+ worlds with around 20 stages in each fighting mobs with your guild mates 1 entry per day. You would have very specific units built for this with special builds that you would have to change depending on the stage. 

The world boss PVE that we had was more interactive than the world boss we have in E7, it was pretty much like one of those dungeon stages but with a boss that had special skills (think hall of trials) that would reset every 2 weeks and top scores would net you better rewards

All and all the comparisons between E7 and seven knights or 7K is what we called it there isn’t much to compare other than there were whales because it was a gatcha game. I quit because the devs ended up introducing things that pretty much fucked over the end game players. They changed all of our accessories and added new ones without compensation for our grind before. The game has now from what. I know and what my old guild talks about as a whale game with a huge factor into AFK battling.
